Chilis Happy Hour: Must-Try Menu Specials for Budget-Friendly Feasting

If you’re on the hunt for some of the best happy hour deals, look no further than Chili’s Grill & Bar. Chili’s is renowned for its enticing happy hour restaurant specials that will perk up your day with tantalizing drink and food specials. Whether you’re dining in or looking to order online, Chili’s happy hour menu is packed with food specials and drink specials that will help slake your thirst and satisfy your snack cravings.

With options like margarita of the month, boneless wings, quesadillas, and free chips and salsa, Chili’s happy hour provides a great opportunity to unwind after a long day or celebrate with friends or co-workers. In this guide, we’ll take a deep dive into everything Chili’s has to offer during their outstanding happy hours. From appetizers to signature drinks, there’s no shortage of deals to enjoy.

What is Chili’s Happy Hour?

Chili’s happy hour is a special time at the restaurant where you can enjoy reduced prices on food specials, drink specials, and appetizers. It’s the best happy hour to indulge in some of your favorite items at a fraction of the cost. The happy hour menu typically includes signature drinks, like the margarita of the month, and delicious starters, like boneless wings and quesadillas, all served with two dipping sauces for added flavor.

Chili’s happy hour is available on select days, usually during the week, and often on Saturdays and Sundays. Be sure to view restaurant hours at your local Chili’s to know when the deals are available, as the happy hour menu may vary by location.

Chili’s Happy Hour Menu with Pricing

Menu Item Description Price
Margarita of the Month Unique margarita available for just $5, changing monthly with flavors like Santa’s Secret Stache or Blackberry Rita. $5
Modelo Draft beer available on tap during happy hour at a discounted price. Varies by location
Signature Drinks Enjoy signature drinks like the Tequila Trifecta or classic well drinks at special prices during happy hour. Varies by location
Boneless Wings Crispy, juicy wings served with your choice of two dipping sauces, including BBQ or Buffalo. $6
Quesadillas Classic Tex-Mex quesadillas packed with flavor, perfect for sharing or as a snack. $5
Free Chips and Salsa Freshly made tortilla chips served with salsa, a great light option to start your happy hour. Free with purchase
Entrees Full entrees at discounted prices, including burgers, fajitas, and more. Varies by location
Loaded Nachos Nachos topped with melted cheese, beans, jalapeños, pico de gallo, and your choice of chicken or beef, served with sour cream. $7
Southwestern Eggrolls Crispy tortillas stuffed with smoked chicken, black beans, corn, jalapeño Jack cheese, and red peppers, served with ranch. $6
Molten Chocolate Cake A warm chocolate cake with a gooey center, topped with vanilla ice cream and a chocolate shell. $7
Skillet Chocolate Chip Cookie A warm, freshly baked chocolate chip cookie served with vanilla ice cream and hot fudge. $6

Drink Specials

The happy hour at Chili’s features a variety of drink specials that include everything from signature margarita creations to wines by the glass. Some popular drinks on the happy hour menu include:

Chili’s Happy Hour Drink Specials

Drink Description
Margarita of the Month Every month, Chili’s offers a unique margarita for just $5. Whether it’s the Santa’s Secret Stache or the Blackberry Rita, it’s a perfect happy hour choice.
Modelo Beer lovers can enjoy a Modelo on tap at a discounted price during happy hour.
Signature Drinks Chili’s offers signature drinks like the Tequila Trifecta for those looking for something with a bit more kick. Well drinks are also available at great prices.

Food Specials

If you’re more interested in food specials to complement your drink specials, Chili’s offers a wide range of mouthwatering options. Some highlights of their happy hour menu include:

Chili’s Happy Hour Menu Highlights

Food Item Description
Boneless Wings Crispy, juicy, and flavorful, served with your choice of two dipping sauces. Whether you’re into BBQ or Buffalo, these boneless wings are a fan favorite.
Quesadillas A Tex-Mex staple, these quesadillas are packed with flavor and make for the perfect happy hour snack.
Free Chips and Salsa If you’re looking for something light to enjoy while sipping your drink, Chili’s free chips and salsa are an excellent way to start your meal.
Entrees If you’re ready for something heartier, Chili’s offers discounts on full entrees during happy hour, making it easy to enjoy a big celebration dinner for less.

Additional Tex-Mex Dishes Available at Chili’s

Dish Description
Fajitas Sizzling fajitas with grilled chicken, steak, or shrimp, served with tortillas, sautéed onions, bell peppers, guacamole, sour cream, and pico de gallo.
Tacos Tacos filled with chicken, shrimp, or beef, topped with fresh lettuce, cheese, and salsa, served with rice and beans.
Southwestern Eggrolls Crispy tortillas stuffed with smoked chicken, black beans, corn, jalapeño Jack cheese, red peppers, served with creamy avocado-ranch sauce.
Enchiladas Chicken or beef enchiladas topped with cheese and enchilada sauce, served with rice and beans.
Loaded Nachos Nachos topped with melted cheese, beans, jalapeños, pico de gallo, and your choice of chicken or beef, served with sour cream and guacamole.
Southwest Chicken Soup A hearty chicken soup with hominy, tomato, and spices, topped with tortilla strips.
Chipotle Chicken Fresh Mex Bowl Grilled chicken over rice, black beans, corn salsa, cheese, and chipotle pesto, topped with avocado, tortilla strips, and chipotle ranch.
Street Corn Grilled Mexican-style street corn with creamy sauce, cotija cheese, chili powder, and lime.

Chili’s Dessert Options

Dessert Description
Molten Chocolate Cake Warm chocolate cake with a gooey center, topped with vanilla ice cream and a hard chocolate shell.
Cheesecake Classic creamy cheesecake with a graham cracker crust, topped with strawberry sauce or caramel drizzle.
Skillet Chocolate Chip Cookie Warm chocolate chip cookie served in a skillet, topped with vanilla ice cream and hot fudge.
Paradise Pie Layers of chocolate, coconut, and walnuts, served warm with vanilla ice cream, hot fudge, and caramel.
Brownie Sundae Fudgy brownie topped with vanilla ice cream, whipped cream, and rich chocolate sauce.
Caramel Apple Tart Warm apple tart with vanilla ice cream and drizzled with caramel sauce, perfect for a seasonal dessert.

 

Dine-In vs. Order Online: What’s the Best Option?

One of the great things about Chili’s is that they offer the flexibility to either dine in or order online. If you’re dining in, you can fully experience the happy hour with friends or co-workers, enjoying the social atmosphere Chili’s is known for. However, if you’re short on time or prefer to enjoy your meal at home, you can easily order online and still take advantage of some of Chili’s happy hour specials.

Don’t forget to view the menu online before placing your order so you don’t miss out on any of the tantalizing drink and food specials.

The Margarita of the Month

What is the Margarita of the Month?

Chili’s Margarita of the Month is an exciting and refreshing promotion where the restaurant offers a new and unique margarita every month for just $5. Whether you’re a fan of traditional margaritas or enjoy trying new flavors, the Margarita of the Month is always a great choice. From the Blackberry Rita to the seasonal Trick or Treat-a-Rita, there’s always something fun and delicious on offer.

This rotating special is available during happy hour, but it’s popular, so make sure to get there early or check if it’s available at your local Chili’s.

Free Chips and Salsa – A Happy Hour Essential

One of the best parts of Chili’s happy hour is the free chips and salsa. It’s simple, classic, and pairs perfectly with any drink or appetizer. Whether you’re enjoying a margarita or a Modelo, the salty crunch of freshly made chips dipped in salsa is the ideal way to kick off your happy hour with friends.

Why Chili’s Happy Hour is the Best Happy Hour in Town

There’s no doubt that Chili’s has one of the best happy hours around. Between the happy hour specials on drinks and food, the relaxed atmosphere, and the ability to either dine in or order online, it’s hard to beat. Here are a few reasons why Chili’s stands out:

What Makes Chili’s Stand Out Why You’ll Love It
Flavor Explosion Whether you’re in the mood for Tex-Mex classics like quesadillas and boneless wings, or want to sample one of their signature margarita creations, there’s something for everyone on the happy hour menu.
Wallet-Friendly Fun Chili’s happy hour specials are designed to give you the best value. Whether it’s a $5 Margarita of the Month or discounted appetizers, you’ll leave satisfied without breaking the bank.
Vibe That Thrives Enjoy your hour with friends or co-workers in a fun and casual setting. The lively atmosphere at Chili’s makes it the perfect place to relax after a long day.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

When is Chili’s Happy Hour?

Chili’s happy hour times vary by location, but they’re usually available in the afternoons and evenings during the week. Be sure to view restaurant hours at your local Chili’s for specific times.

Can I Order Happy Hour Items Online?

Yes, Chili’s allows you to order online and enjoy some of their happy hour specials at home. Check the view menu section of your local Chili’s website for availability.

What Drink Specials Are Available?

Chili’s offers a range of drink specials during happy hour, including margaritas, Modelo, and signature drinks like the Tequila Trifecta.

Is There a Shortage of Deals at Chili’s Happy Hour?

Definitely not! Chili’s is recognized for offering outstanding happy hours with no shortage of deals on both food and drinks.

What Appetizers Are Included in Happy Hour?

Some of the most popular appetizers on the happy hour menu include boneless wings, quesadillas, and free chips and salsa.

Are There Any Special Days for Happy Hour?

Yes, in addition to weekdays, Chili’s often extends their happy hour specials to Saturdays and Sundays. Be sure to check your local Chili’s for exact times.

Conclusion

Chili’s happy hour offers something for everyone, whether you’re in the mood for drink specials, margaritas, or a delicious appetizer like boneless wings. With a menu that’s packed with options, it’s no wonder Chili’s is known for having the best happy hours around. So, whether you’re enjoying an hour with friends or co-workers, or having a big celebration dinner, Chili’s happy hour menu is the perfect way to enjoy fantastic food and drinks without breaking the bank.

Be sure to check your local Chili’s for their happy hour times and menu deals, and don’t forget to order online if you prefer to enjoy the fun from home.
